description: Set who may read a program: its visibility and the WHOLE lists of reader people and teams, replacing the stored ones. Read them first with anyforge_get_program_access and send its `access.revision` as `ifRevision` (the access revision, not the program's); a stale one is refused with `program_access_modified`. Private: only the listed people, members of the listed teams, the program's lead and owner and its roster read it. Only the program's lead or owner, or a company Owner, may change it. Making a program private needs private programs to be available in the workspace; so does making it closed, which keeps the same readers and also shows every member its name and lead so they can ask to join. Opening a private or closed program makes everything in it visible to every member, so a first attempt is refused with `declassification_unconfirmed`: show the person that and repeat with `confirmDeclassify: true` only after they confirm. Requires `write` scope and a key that acts as a person.

confirmDeclassify.description: Opening a private or closed program: true only after a person confirmed, following a `declassification_unconfirmed` refusal. Never on a first attempt.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifRevision.description: The `access.revision` you read (the access revision, not the program's `revision`).

memberUids.description: The whole list of people (member uids) who may read it. Omitted = none.

teamIds.description: The whole list of teams whose direct members may read it. Omitted = none.

visibility.description: open: every member reads it. private: only its readers. closed: only its readers, and every member sees its name and lead and may ask to join.

name: anyforge_set_program_access
title: Set program access
